query:

  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50 AND radar_warmth = 50 AND radar_sweetness = 50 AND radar_spiciness = 50 AND radar_earthiness = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as default_profiles
FROM molecules
